source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.habit: Freely branched stems, decumbent or ascending, sometimes erect, to 80 cm
morphology_source_reported.leaves: Gland-dotted; broadly lanceolate to rhombic, elliptic or obovate leaflets, generally 20–50 mm long and (6–)10–24 mm wide [species key]
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Often sweet-clover-scented, 12–20 mm long; blue or purplish
morphology_source_reported.fruits: Gland-dotted; body completely enclosed by calyx
